comment: Known decrypted EBOOTs of J-Stars Victory VS+ for installer check E3 (firstrun.py), in the shared EBOOT id table format: ids, sizes and SHA-256 hashes only, never game files or keys. sha256 and size: the decrypted EBOOT.elf, whole file. self_sha256: the disc's encrypted EBOOT.BIN. segment_sha256: firstrun.segment_hash(). status tested: the port was built and run on this build. Measured on the 1.00 discs of both regions; game update 1.02 is not listed (its EBOOT has not been measured). installer/jsp.iss repeats the two sha256 values for the wizard's region check (firstrun_selftest.py checks they match).
